audience: teams who run a public status page on StatusPal

useCases.title: Check the current status of each service
useCases.text: The AI reads the overall status of the status page, lists its services, and reads the status of a single service.

useCases.title: Review incidents and their state
useCases.text: The AI lists incidents, filtered by type and paged with cursors, and opens single ones. You get a short summary of what happened.

useCases.title: Check upcoming maintenance and notices
useCases.text: The AI reads the full summary of the status page: maintenances, upcoming maintenances, info notices and incidents.

useCases.title: See which metrics the status page shows
useCases.text: The AI lists the metrics configured on a status page and puts them next to the current status.

useCases.title: Publish a new incident or maintenance window
useCases.text: The AI publishes an incident (major or minor) or a scheduled maintenance to the live status page. It can notify subscribers when you ask for it.

useCases.title: Post an update on, change or delete an incident
useCases.text: The AI posts an update to an incident (for example investigating to resolved), changes its title, type, services or timing, or deletes it from the live page.
